name: ai.robosystems/mcp-bridge
title: RoboSystems MCP Bridge
description: One local connection for every RoboSystems graph an API key covers: books, SEC filings, subgraphs

environmentVariables.name: ROBOSYSTEMS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: A RoboSystems API key. An account-wide key reaches every graph; a key scoped to one graph also needs ROBOSYSTEMS_GRAPH_ID. Create one in the app under Settings, API Keys.

environmentVariables.name: ROBOSYSTEMS_GRAPH_IDS
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Limits the connection to these graphs and their subgraphs: ids or alias=id pairs separated by commas, with :ro to make one read-only.

environmentVariables.name: ROBOSYSTEMS_GRAPH_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Connects one graph only, with that graph's own tools: sec, a graph id, or a subgraph id.

environmentVariables.name: ROBOSYSTEMS_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to true to withhold every write tool.

environmentVariables.name: ROBOSYSTEMS_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. The API address of a stack you run yourself; the hosted API is the default.
